function.name: login_user
function.description: Logs in the user to authenticate the user to access their account. The identification used can either be a password or a driver's license. Returns true or false for login success or failure.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

anyOf.description: The driver's license of the user

drivers_license_id.description: The unique ID of the driver's license used for identification.

drivers_license_state.description: The state in which the driver's license is registered.

function.name: logout_user
function.description: Logs out the user by forgetting all user-said information. Returns true always because logout is successful.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

function.name: update_policy
function.description: Updates the user's policy with a new type, coverage amount, also taking in the income. Returns true or false for successful policy update.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

coverage_amount.description: The coverage amount of the user's healthcare policy, specified in monetary units.

annual_income.description: The annual income of a user.

function.name: submit_claim
function.description: Submits a new claim to the user's healthcare policy, providing an amount, description, and provider ID. Returns true or false for successful claim submission.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

amount.description: The amount of money for a transaction, claim, or payment in monetary units.

description.description: A brief description or reason for a claim or policy update.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier of the healthcare provider submitting the claim.

function.name: get_claim_details
function.description: Retrieves the details of a specific claim based on the claim ID. This includes the status, amount, description, and date. Returns a dictionary of the claim details, an empty dictionary if the claim does not exist, or false if retrieval conditions are not met.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

claim_id.description: The unique identifier for a specific claim submitted under the user's policy.

function.name: get_policy_details
function.description: Retrieves the user's healthcare policy details, including coverage, authorized providers, and enrollment date. Returns a dictionary of the policy details.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

function.name: add_authorized_provider
function.description: Adds a new authorized provider to the user's policy. Returns true or false for successful addition of a provider.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier for a healthcare provider in the system.

function.name: get_provider_details
function.description: Retrieves a provider's details, including service_type, name, and status. Returns a dictionary of a provider's details.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier for a healthcare provider in the system.

function.name: get_claim_history
function.description: Retrieves a history of all claims submitted under the user's policy. Returns a list of all claims under the user's policy.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

function.name: deactivate_policy
function.description: Deactivates the user's policy by setting it to inactive with zero coverage. Returns true or false for successful policy deactivation.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

function.name: reactivate_policy
function.description: Reactivates the user's policy with a specified type and coverage amount. Returns true or false for successful policy reactivation.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

coverage_amount.description: The coverage amount of the user's healthcare policy, specified in monetary units.

annual_income.description: The annual income of a user.

function.name: appeal_claim
function.description: Appeals a previously denied claim for the user Returns true if the claim appeal is successfully submitted, otherwise false.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

claim_id.description: The unique identifier for a specific claim submitted under the user's policy.

function.name: schedule_appointment
function.description: Schedules an appointment for a user with a provider on the specified date.  Returns true if the appointment is successfully scheduled, otherwise false.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier for a healthcare provider in the system.

appointment_date.description: The date set for an appointment. This date must be in the format of: %Y-%m-%d. An example is 2023-05-10.

function.name: internal_check_username_exist
function.description: Checks if some username exists within the database. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true or false based on the condition that the inputted username exists in the database.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

function.name: internal_check_provider_exists
function.description: Checks if a provider exists in the database. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true or false based on whether the provider exists in the database.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier for a healthcare provider in the system.

function.name: internal_check_claim_exists
function.description: Checks if a specific claim exists under the user's policy. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true or false based on whether the claim exists under the user's policy.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

claim_id.description: The unique identifier for a specific claim submitted under the user's policy.

function.name: internal_get_interaction_time
function.description: Retrieves the current interaction timestamp recorded in the database. This is an internal action, only accessible by the assistant. Returns the current interaction time as a string in ISO 8601 format.
